purpose: Prospectively test whether preserving the union of the unchanged four atomic roles' top-two proposals can avoid the recall loss of aggressive adaptive cardinality while retaining a measurable evidence-cost reduction on an untouched long-document evidence-selection dataset.

development_boundary.aggregate_failure_signal_known: The published v47 candidate reduced evidence units but exceeded the frozen recall-loss limit.
development_boundary.v48_formula_source: A rank-only proposal-preservation invariant and synthetic counterexamples; no QASPER validation content, score distribution, label frequency or metric was used.

official_sources.license: CC-BY-4.0 as stated by the frozen official dataset card; verify the frozen repository README and source archive hash before opening the dev member

allowed_metadata_seen: official dataset name, task summary, paper-level and question-level counts
official schema documentation for full_text, figures_and_tables, questions, answers and paragraph-level evidence
official license, source URL, archive checksum and public repository revisions
official paper statement that separate NLP practitioners supplied supporting evidence
pre_registration_access_disclosure.incidental_content_disclosure: The public Hugging Face dataset-card page rendered a preview of several training rows while license and schema metadata were checked.

source_access_order: Implement and test the selector, QASPER adapter, multi-reference metric, sealed sampling, blind-cache boundary and report writer using synthetic fixtures only.
Register protocol, module, runner and test hashes before acquiring the official archive or opening validation content.
Acquire the registered archive without printing or browsing the validation member.
Verify archive hash, frozen repository metadata and CC-BY-4.0 declaration before opening the validation member.
Run a structural census and exact evidence-to-candidate alignment audit; stop before query generation if scope, ambiguity or candidate-ceiling rules fail.
Generate every query and neural score without answer, evidence, annotation, answer type or gold-reference fields.
Join all eligible answer-level gold evidence references once after complete ordered query and score caches validate.
Publish favorable, null, negative or inconclusive results and never tune or select a method on v48 cases.

eligible_question: paper has a stable id, nonempty question id and nonempty question text
paper contains at least three nonempty full-text paragraph or figure/table caption candidates
at least one answer annotation is answerable and supplies a nonempty evidence list
every evidence string in every retained answer-level reference maps after frozen whitespace normalization to exactly one canonical paragraph or float candidate
duplicate or ambiguous normalized candidate text makes that question ineligible rather than changing the mapping rule
dataset_scope.sampling_rule: Sort eligible validation question ids by SHA-256 of 'FRC-QASPER-V48|' plus question_id and then question_id; select the first 600 without replacement. If 500 to 599 are eligible, use all. If fewer than 500 are eligible, stop before query generation.
dataset_scope.multi_reference_gold: Retain each distinct nonempty answer-level evidence set as an alternative gold reference; do not union references. Per-case precision, recall and F1 use the reference with maximum F1, with canonical reference tuple as the deterministic tie-breaker.

blind_candidate_construction.paragraph_units: One candidate per nonempty full_text paragraph, canonical id paragraph_<section_index>_<paragraph_index>; candidate text includes the section name and paragraph.
blind_candidate_construction.float_units: One candidate per nonempty figures_and_tables caption, canonical id float_<index>; evidence may match either the normalized caption or the normalized 'FLOAT SELECTED: ' plus caption form, but both forms must resolve to the same unique candidate.
blind_candidate_construction.pool: Every nonempty paragraph and figure/table caption from the attached paper; no evidence-driven pruning, answer matching, training retrieval or first-stage truncation.
stored_blind_fields: opaque case id and paper commitment
blind_candidate_construction.candidate_ceiling_registration: After sealed sampling and blind candidate construction, gold references may be used only to verify exact candidate coverage and freeze pre-neural strata. No method, threshold, prompt, sample member or candidate member may change afterward.
blind_candidate_construction.protective_behavior: Any unmapped or ambiguous evidence, duplicate canonical id, forbidden blind key, case-order mismatch, nondeterministic rerun or candidate-ceiling failure stops before neural work and writes no score cache.

frozen_models.score_calibration: per-case independent min-max inherited from v41

candidate_method_formula: Compute the unchanged four v41 dynamic atomic-role score columns for every candidate.
For each role, rank candidates by descending role score with canonical id as the only tie-breaker.
Let P be the union of each role's available rank-1 and rank-2 candidate ids.

Restrict candidate eligibility to P and select up to target_cardinality candidates with the unchanged v41 dynamic rank-coverage greedy objective and deterministic tie-breaking under the frozen token budget.
When abs(P) is at most five and the budget can hold all proposals, the selected set must equal P; when P is larger, the rank-coverage objective resolves which five proposals are retained.
No score magnitude threshold, source kind, paragraph position, answer, evidence, annotation count, gold count, answer type, dataset statistic or post-result rule may alter P, the target or selection.

query_generation.fallback: frozen label-neutral templates plus the original question

evaluation.gold_join: After complete ordered query and score caches validate, attach alternative answer-level evidence-reference id sets and pre-neural strata to the opaque cases.
evaluation.primary_metric: mean across budgets of maximum-reference evidence macro F1
evaluation.macro_precision: Mean per-case precision against the alternative reference that maximizes case F1.
evaluation.macro_recall: Mean per-case recall against the same deterministically selected reference.
evaluation.macro_f1: Mean per-case maximum F1 over distinct answer-level evidence references.
evaluation.complete_reference_recall: A case is complete when at least one alternative evidence reference is a subset of the selected ids.
mandatory_strata: one versus multiple evidence units in the smallest alternative reference
one versus multiple alternative evidence references
extractive versus free-form versus yes/no answer type when unambiguous across retained references
paper candidate-count quartiles frozen before neural scoring
target cardinality below five versus equal to five
secondary_metrics: selected unit count and token cost
selection-set difference rates versus dynamic v41, v44 and v46

decision_rules.gate_2: Always remains NO-GO/SHADOW in v48; one public scientific-paper evidence-selection result cannot authorize CANARY or DEFAULT.
decision_rules.publication: Publish favorable, null, negative or inconclusive results with source, protocol, implementation, cache and result hashes.
claims_forbidden: official QASPER answer-generation or evidence-selection leaderboard result

known_scope_limits: QASPER supplies the full paper attached to each question rather than an open-corpus retrieval task.
Evidence strings are evaluated at paragraph or figure/table-caption granularity, not highlighted-sentence granularity.
Alternative answer annotations are treated as alternative gold references rather than unioned evidence.
The endpoint is evidence selection, not answer generation or scientific claim verification.
Scientific-paper evidence cannot replace district flood-domain expert evaluation.
